spans.s: (khoḍa, adj., = Skt. Lex. and late lit., Schmidt, Nachträge; Class. Skt. khora, Lex. also khola; lame, in a list of adj. for bodily deformities, noms. or accs.: Mv 〔ii.150.9〕; 〔152.3〕; 〔153.19〕; 〔156.11〕 (in 〔150.9〕 ed. with mss. khāḍo, mere corruption; in 〔152.3〕 ed. also khāḍo, but the only ms. khoḍo); in all preceded by kāṇo (or kāṇaṃ) vā, then khoḍo (˚ḍaṃ) vā dadrulo (˚laṃ, or other variant, see this) vā …)
